description: shadcn-svelte's Button, Badge and Card compiled from their unmodified sources (M6 library modules, docs/design/M6-LIBRARIES.md#library-modules-step-3): <script module> tv() variants exported through index.ts barrels, `$lib` imports (runic.json alias), Card's parts as <Card.Root> through a namespace import, cn from the cn package re-exported by lib/utils.ts, class props whose values come from the instantiation sites (prop domains, enumerated per site), href turning Button into a link and Badge's <svelte:element>, children snippets and rest props (id, aria-label, onclick). Clicks change a variant, a size, a class and disabled (a disabled Button link loses its href); hover, Tab focus (focus-visible ring), links followed by click and by Enter (fragment navigations: popstate, hashchange, the same link again replacing the entry). The lucide icons are drawn in the theme's oklch colours through currentColor; they are paint only, too small for the whole-viewport pixel gate, so screenshots of this case are inspected when Blitz changes (checked 2026-10-04)
